info.description: A production-grade Job Recruitment REST API built with Go and Gin.
info.title: HireFlow API

get.description: Returns all applications submitted by the current candidate.
Returns a single application. Candidate sees own only; recruiter sees their job's only.

delete.description: Permanently removes the candidate's application. Candidate only.

patch.description: Advances or rejects an application in the pipeline. Recruiter only.

post.description: Authenticate with email and password, receive a JWT token

get.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user

post.description: Creates a new candidate or recruiter account

get.description: Returns a list of all companies. Public endpoint.

post.description: Creates a new company. Admin only.

get.description: Returns a single company by ID. Public endpoint.

post.description: Creates a job under a company. Recruiter only.

get.description: Returns all open job postings. Public endpoint.
Returns a single job posting by ID. Public endpoint.

put.description: Updates a job posting. Only the recruiter who posted it.

delete.description: Deletes a job posting. Only the recruiter who posted it.

get.description: Lists all applications for a job. Only the recruiter who posted it.

post.description: Submit an application to an open job. Candidate only.

patch.description: Marks a job as closed. Only the recruiter who posted it.

post.description: Returns a pre-signed S3 URL for uploading a PDF CV directly to S3.
